title: SynthOpt
summary: SynthOpt is a Python package for generating, evaluating, and optimising the privacy/utility trade-off of synthetic tabular and multi-table data. Its evaluation modules import SDV's SingleTableMetadata for schema definition and use sdmetrics' single-column, column-pair and single-table metric classes directly to score utility, quality and privacy of generated data.
